Cors._comment: Browser origins allowed to call this API cross-origin. Empty = same-origin deployment (reverse proxy), the preferred setup. Development overrides add the local WASM editor host. '*' is refused in code.

Smtp._comment: Outgoing mail. No secret lives here: set Smtp__Password as an environment variable (IIS: Configuration Editor → appSettings, or the app pool's environment) so it never reaches source control. With Host unset the app runs with email disabled — IEmailService.IsConfigured is false and every caller checks it.
Smtp._ports: Security=SslOnConnect pairs with port 465 (TLS from the first byte). Use StartTls with 587, or 3325 where an ISP blocks 587.

AzureAd._comment: Placeholder identifiers only — the real registration lives in appsettings.Development.json (gitignored). This file previously named the RETIRED registration e75f71ef, superseded 2026-07-18, so anyone running without the Development override wired auth to a dead app.

Serilog._comment_MinimumLevel: EF Core logs every executed SQL statement — text and parameter values — at INFORMATION, not Debug, so lowering the default does not quiet it. Measured: 654 lines of a 394 KB log, and 170 from sixteen requests. Left alone it is both the bulk of the volume and a route for row data into the log. Development turns it back up when a query needs watching. NOTE: keys inside Override are logger names, not free-form — a comment key there is read as a source and crashes startup.
